common.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
common.errorForbidden: Your role in this agency doesn't allow this.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back to Verploy.
login.errorInvalid: Email address or password is incorrect.
login.errorUnconfirmed: Please confirm your email address first using the link in your inbox.

signup.title: Create an account
signup.subtitle: Start your 14-day trial. No credit card required.
signup.checkEmailBody: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to continue.
signup.errorExists: An account with this email address already exists. Sign in or reset your password.
signup.errorWeak: Choose a password of at least 10 characters.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.body: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for {email}, the link is now in your inbox.

auth.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.

onboarding.title: Create your agency
onboarding.body: Your agency is where your sites, team and reports come together.
onboarding.name: Agency name
onboarding.errorAlready: You already belong to an agency.
onboarding.errorName: Give your agency a name of at least 2 characters.

invite.title: Invitation
invite.body: You've been invited to join {agency} as {role}.
invite.loginFirst: Sign in or create an account with {email} to accept the invitation.
invite.errorInvalid: This invitation is invalid, has expired or has already been used.
invite.errorMismatch: This invitation is for a different email address. Sign out and sign in with the invited address.
invite.errorAlready: You already belong to an agency. An account can belong to one agency.

dashboard.title: Sites
dashboard.summary: {count, plural, one {# site} other {# sites}} · {online} online
dashboard.emptyBody: Connect your first WordPress site. It takes about two minutes.
dashboard.trialBanner: Trial: {days, plural, one {# day left} other {# days left}}.
dashboard.readOnlyBanner: Your trial or subscription has ended. Monitoring continues, but new sites and updates are blocked.

sitesNew.title: Add site
sitesNew.name: Name
sitesNew.errorUrl: Enter a valid web address, for example https://client.com.
sitesNew.errorEmail: Enter a valid email address or leave the field empty.
sitesNew.errorDuplicate: This site is already in your agency.
sitesNew.errorLimit: Your plan ({plan}) allows up to {limit} sites. Upgrade to connect more sites.
sitesNew.errorInactive: Your trial or subscription has ended. You can add new sites again once your subscription is active.
sitesNew.errorForbidden: Only owners and admins can add sites.

siteDetail.connectIntro: Connect the site with a one-time code. The code is valid for 30 minutes and works only once.
siteDetail.step1: Download the Verploy Connector and install it on the site: Plugins → Add New Plugin → Upload Plugin.
siteDetail.step2: In WordPress, go to Settings → Verploy.
siteDetail.step3: Paste the connection code and click Connect.
siteDetail.waiting: Waiting for the plugin… This page refreshes automatically once the site is connected.
siteDetail.repairBody: Needed after reinstalling the plugin, or if you want to replace this site's key. The current connection keeps working until the new code is used.
siteDetail.updatesAvailable: {count, plural, one {# update available} other {# updates available}}
siteDetail.componentsEmpty: No data yet. It appears after the first heartbeat.
siteDetail.dangerBody: Removes the site and all its data from Verploy. The plugin on the site will stop reporting.
siteDetail.deleteConfirm: Type the site name ({name}) to confirm.

settings.title: Agency settings
settings.name: Agency name
settings.errorColor: Use a hex code such as #22D98A.

team.title: Team
team.roleHelp: Owners manage everything, including team and subscription. Admins manage sites. Members can view everything.
team.inviteLinkHelp: Share this link. It's valid for 7 days and only works for this email address.
team.errorLastOwner: An agency must have at least one owner.
team.errorAlreadyMember: This person is already a member of your agency.

email.inviteBody: {inviter} invites you to join {agency} on Verploy as {role}.
email.inviteFooter: This link is valid for 7 days. Weren't expecting this email? You can ignore it.
email.alertFooter: You receive this because you are an owner or admin of {agency} in Verploy.
email.recoveredBody: {site} is responding again. The site had been offline since {since}.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.intro: Verploy checks every site continuously. Everything that needs attention appears here.
alerts.empty: No open alerts. Everything is fine.
alerts.emptyResolved: No resolved alerts in the past 30 days.

site_offline.title: Site is offline
site_offline.body: No contact with the site since {since}. Check whether the site and server are reachable.

ssl_expiring.title: {days, plural, =0 {SSL certificate has expired} one {SSL certificate expires in # day} other {SSL certificate expires in # days}}
ssl_expiring.body: The certificate is valid until {date}. Renew it or check that automatic renewal works.

ssl_invalid.title: SSL certificate is invalid
ssl_invalid.body: Visitors see a security warning. Cause: {reason}.

ssl_missing.title: Site does not use HTTPS
ssl_missing.body: The site is set to http://. Install an SSL certificate and change the address to https://.

domain_expiring.title: {days, plural, =0 {Domain name has expired} one {Domain name expires in # day} other {Domain name expires in # days}}
domain_expiring.body: The registration ends on {date}. Renew the domain with the registrar.

php_eol_past.title: PHP {version} no longer receives security updates
php_eol_past.body: Support ended on {date}. Upgrade to a supported PHP version.

php_eol_soon.title: PHP {version} receives security updates until {date}
php_eol_soon.body: Plan the upgrade to a newer PHP version before that date.

memory_low.title: Memory limit is low ({mb} MB)
memory_low.body: WordPress recommends at least 128 MB, and 256 MB for heavier sites. Increase memory_limit with the host.

disk_low.title: Low disk space ({mb} MB free)
disk_low.body: When the disk is full, updates, uploads and backups fail. Clean up or increase storage.

core_update.title: WordPress {version} is available
core_update.body: A new version of WordPress is available. Safe updating follows in the Verploy update flow.

plugin_updates.title: {count, plural, one {# plugin or theme update available} other {# plugin and theme updates available}}
plugin_updates.body: See the list on the site's page.
